name: KanVQA
description: KanVQA is a Kannada Visual Question Answering (VQA) benchmark pairing Microsoft COCO imagery with parallel English and Kannada question-answer annotations derived from VQA v2.0. The dataset comprises a 20,000-example machine-translated training split (kanvqa_silver_train_20k_native.csv) and a 1,000-example human-verified evaluation split (kanvqa_gold_verified.csv).
